_note: The 15 frozen INVALID reasons, in verify order, each in plain words. Single source for the CLI/SDK/MCP/console legends and docs. The strings themselves are frozen (they match crates/ainra-core/src/verify.rs and packages/sdk-ts Reason); only these glosses are editorial.
valid: All nine checks passed — genuine, in-window, in-scope, logged, and not revoked.
schema_violation: Not a well-formed passport, or it carries a forbidden (identity/score/money) field.
name_malformed: The subject or issuer name doesn't fit the AINRA name grammar.
unknown_registrar: The issuing registrar isn't in the signed directory (not accredited).
not_yet_valid: Presented before its validity window opens (now < nbf).
expired: Its validity window has closed (now >= exp) — no grace, no skew.
sig_invalid: An issuer signature failed to verify.
alg_downgrade: Only one of the two required signatures (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65) was present or valid.
ceiling_exceeded: The capabilities claimed exceed the scope ceiling.
chain_widening: A delegation hop granted more than it held — delegation may only narrow.
chain_expired: A delegation hop is outside its own validity window.
stale_status: The revocation status is too old for the required freshness class (fails closed).
revoked: The lineage's revocation bit is set — it has been revoked.
mandate_revoked: A mandate in the signed permission path has been revoked.
not_logged: The credential can't be proven present in the transparency log (logged-before-valid failed).
checkpoint_invalid: The log checkpoint isn't signed by a currently-valid delegate.
